abstract: Complementary all-atom structure predictors sample different solutions, but how to allocate a fixed sampling budget across them and select the best output remains unclear. Thal-Kak unifies five released predictors under shared upstream inputs and a common schema. Across FoldBench and CASP16, model mixing improves oracle sampling over single-model runs, but selection remains a bottleneck because confidence scores do not transfer across models and existing quality-assessment methods cannot resolve this gap.
